annotations.text:
Drive it in this order:

1  Run          events stream in, state moves
2  (wait)       no_phantom_promise fires at seq 07,
                inventory_nonneg at seq 09
3  Fork at seq 0   main | governed, 2 violations -> 0
4  Replay       same seed, identical hash
5  actor: claude   badge flips PINNED -> STABLE and the
                replay claim is withdrawn on its own

For the build:

Tokens are the docs/ house sheet, so the app and
the spec are the same design language.

PINNED = --ok    STABLE = --warn    RECORDED = --crit

The theme chip above the console switches light/dark —
check it in both themes before shipping the artboard.
